Starter template for test automation projects: **Playwright + TypeScript**, UI and API tests in one suite, **Allure** reporting with history, **GitHub Actions** CI, and code quality checks on every commit.

Click **Use this template** to start a new project with everything below already set up.

## What v1.0.0 means

The suite is complete for its scope and green in CI; the README follows the portfolio standard, and the test plan and test summary report (ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3) are in `docs/`. Later versions will be tagged when the scope grows.
